scope.implementation_review_limit: The new prototype source was not yet present when inspected. This is a feasibility audit of the equations and contract supplied by root and the source author, anchored to the frozen existing operator. A later source freeze/runtime receipt remains necessary.
scope.actual_U19_failure_context: Root reports completed/published U19, all13 scalar adjacency checks stable while the independent5percent potential-only interface screen still fails. The supplied figures13.9403/all and48.5892/periphery were not independently recalculated or decoded by this source-only audit. No old failure is cleared.

mathematical_contract.domain: The identical XY0.5mm, center-inside-D50 cylinder staircase graph extruded through physical layers0.1/5/5/15mm; no missing outside XY edges and insulating physical bottom. This remains a spatially discretized lateral graph, not the smooth continuous cylinder.
mathematical_contract.assumptions: Scalar isotropic gamma, constant across each XY layer; each layer gamma equals its exact source-verified value at the selected carrier. Horizontal heterogeneity, arbitrarily rotated anisotropy or changed side boundary destroys the stated simple modal separation.
mathematical_contract.lateral_operator: L=(diag(degree)-adjacency)/h^2, with one node per original XY column, h in metres. L is real symmetric positive semidefinite, has units m^-2 and exactly one constant zero mode if the graph is connected. L must be verified against the original graph ordering/edges/mask rather than using a periodic, square-grid or smooth-cylinder eigensystem.
mathematical_contract.modal_equation: For L q=lambda q, k=sqrt(lambda), v''=lambda*v and downward J=-gamma*v'. Use real orthonormal eigenvectors Q; Q^T is correct because Q is real. Eigenvector signs and repeated-eigenvalue rotations do not change Q diag(Y) Q^T when modes with equal eigenvalues receive equal Y.
mathematical_contract.admittance_recurrence: Starting with insulated-bottom Ybelow=0, each layer has Ytop=gamma*k*(Ybelow+gamma*k*tanh(k*d))/(gamma*k+Ybelow*tanh(k*d)). Y has units S/m^2. The formula agrees with the frozen admittance_profile after algebraic rearrangement.
mathematical_contract.zero_mode: Handle lambda0=0 explicitly: for this insulated-bottom problem every layer has Y0=0 and a constant potential profile. Do not evaluate0/0 or replace negative eigenvalues by abs(lambda). The general k-to-zero transfer with a nonzero load is Ytop=Ybelow/(1+d*Ybelow/gamma), but that is not the current bottom boundary.
mathematical_contract.surface_tissue_operator: K=h^2*Q*diag(Ytop)*Q^T maps nodal surface potential in V to inward tissue current in A. The h^2 factor is required; omitting it confuses current density and integrated node current. K is complex symmetric, generally not Hermitian, and should satisfy the passive real-power quadratic form.
mathematical_contract.CEM_surface_and_metals: For each contact patch on node i, g=A_patch/z_specific, in S. D_ii sums all patch g, C_i,e sums g only for output pad e. Surface equation (K+D)*phi-C*u=0. Output metal equation -C^T*phi+diag(sum_output_g+1/50)*u=0.01*basis. Ground-return pads2/3 contribute to D with metal0 and have no independent metal unknown. The inactive output still retains its50ohm to ideal0V; it is not open circuit or an isolated bipolar return.
mathematical_contract.SC_contact_double_counting: Contact g must use A/z_specific only because phi is at the physical top and the analytic layer transfer already includes all0.1mm SC. Reusing the old FVM z_specific+dzSC/(2*gammaSC) contact term would double-count SC. Conversely, identifying this physical-top phi as the old first-cell-center phi would change the measurement definition silently.
mathematical_contract.source_and_power: One basis is ideal0.5Vpeak through50ohm, RHS0.01A, other ideal source0 through50ohm. Use peak+jomega*t and S=V*conj(I)/2. The expression0.5*phi^H*K*phi is the conjugate of input complex power under this convention; its real part gives the same real power. Preserve signed complex-power conventions explicitly rather than inferring reactive signs from real-loss matrices.
mathematical_contract.verdict: The proposed recurrence, scaling and coupled equations are sound for the stated graph-by-continuous-z reference. No source-level mathematical blocker requires a larger phantom, extra outputs or altered50ohm/common-return topology. This is not a convergence or experimental certificate.

unknowns_cells_and_work_semantics.vertical_unknowns: Continuous analytic layer profiles, not101 finite-volume z unknowns. Modal layer states are derived profile parameters; state-array entries must not be mislabeled physical cells.
unknowns_cells_and_work_semantics.evaluation_grid: The existing U19 physical evaluation grid has793860 cells/points with its exact native weights and is within the unchanged800000 limit. A future reconstruction can sample at those centers; the algorithm's surface/modal unknown count and sampled evaluation-cell count must both be recorded.
unknowns_cells_and_work_semantics.registration_requirement: Register this as a new numerical reference method with its own unknown/evaluation/storage counts. Do not present it as unchanged FVM, a cached field reconstruction or a reinterpretation of the historical cell cap.
unknowns_cells_and_work_semantics.first_finite_benchmark: Graph construction/eigendecomposition plus modal/manufactured backend checks only; actual CEM phantom reference conditions0 and actual CEM RHS0. Record numerical preprocessing/MMS work and elapsed resources truthfully.
unknowns_cells_and_work_semantics.later_CEM_stage: Two new2000Hz transfer RHS are new reference-physics solves, not cached QA. More frequencies require new frequency-specific gamma/contact DtN and CEM solves, even if the geometry eigensystem is reused. One carrier cannot provide TIS modulation.

first_benchmark_required_contracts: Preregister the exact original XY mask/index ordering/edge list, h, connected-component count, symmetry, row sums, degree bounds and expected7860nodes. Check sparse graph action agrees with the existing unweighted XY stencil before diagonalization.

Freeze a supported installed eigensolver/backend/driver/thread choice and source/environment provenance without installation. Observe effective CPU/BLAS limits; do not assume4-core speedup from an affinity setting.

Preregister absolute/relative symmetry, constant-null-mode, negative-eigenvalue and eigen-residual tolerances. Clip only a justified roundoff-sized zero eigenvalue after checking its vector; any materially negative eigenvalue or extra zero mode fails closed.

Use bounded eigen-residual and orthogonality checks against the sparse original graph. Avoid allocating full LQ, Q^TQ or another n-by-n residual. Record whether orthogonality is full blocked checking or a sampled/probe check; do not label sampled checks exhaustive.
Check real-Q forward/inverse transforms with complex vectors split into real/imag parts, modal action and round-trip errors; no complex Q or dense complex K is required.

Compare layer DtN against independent bottom-up transfer and homogeneous closed form, constant zero mode, small-k limit, layered nonzero-current slab and finite passive admittance. Keep physical k and discrete graph k=sqrt(lambda) references distinct.

For manufactured nonzero modes retain exact analytic interface V/J and side errors plus the sampled2/2 and3/3 fits at declared depths. A better fit or exact-by-construction continuity must not be substituted for independent operator/profile error.

Use stable tanh/scaled exponential or equivalent bounded profile evaluation; check denominator conditioning, underflow/overflow and finite values across the full registered eigenvalue range. A direct large-cosh upward transfer can be ill-conditioned despite a finite result.
No CEM/field/probe/physiology claims from the backend benchmark. Publish measured benchmark resources and success or preserved failure before choosing the actual reference solve.

resource_feasibility.policy: Maximum4 effective CPU and total owned-process RSS plus ALL task-owned tmpfs8,000,000,000bytes, subject to smaller observed limits; one numerical owner, dual locks and finite watchdog. Java heap2GiB remains historical Java-only constraint; a Python/LAPACK eigen stage does not turn that into an8GB Java heap. No limit was queried or changed in this audit.
resource_feasibility.starting_tmpfs_context: Root supplied approximately2.9GB of existing task tmpfs. This is context, not a fresh inventory by the reviewer.
resource_feasibility.memory_verdict: Potentially feasible but unverified. Dense L, returned Q, an implicit input copy, LAPACK driver workspace, Python/BLAS allocations, diagnostics and persistent Q chunks can coexist. One matrix's494MB size is not a peak estimate. Require an explicit allocation-lifetime plan and a live monitor before admitting the finite benchmark.
resource_feasibility.copy_control: Build the registered real matrix in the backend's required layout, select overwrite/copy flags honestly and measure peak RSS. Reuse or release dense L only after sparse graph residual validation can still be performed. Never retain complex Q or form dense complex K for convenience.
resource_feasibility.tmpfs_accounting: Persisted eigen chunks add about one real basis to task-owned tmpfs while RSS/workspace may still be live. Continue RSS+alltasktmpfs accounting during export and publication; mapping a tmpfs file does not exempt either component under the approved conservative accounting metric.
resource_feasibility.transport_chunk_risk: The source author initially proposed eigen chunks up to70MiB. Existing native owners use MAX_BLOB64MiB;70MiB would exceed that transport guard. Use chunks<=32MiB with complete dtype/endianness/order/row-column-range metadata and SHA, or explicitly verify the actual owner transport limit before source freeze. Storage overrides do not remove provider/API transport limits.
resource_feasibility.time_verdict: A600second finite benchmark may be attempted only after source/resource registration; no source-only proof guarantees full7860-eigenvector decomposition and validation within that duration on the available backend. Timeout, resource failure or numerical failure must preserve a checkpoint and exact resume condition.
resource_feasibility.future_CEM_risk: Each matrix-free complex matvec needs repeated real-Q transforms. Iteration count, preconditioning and multi-depth reconstruction may dominate wall time. K is not Hermitian; standard Hermitian CG is not justified. Use an appropriate registered solver with physical residuals, current balance and power/passivity gates before claiming a CEM solution.

future_field_and_interpretation_holds: Label the reference as the exact continuous-z solution of the fixed lateral graph, to numerical eigensolver/CEM tolerance. It is not the exact smooth-cylinder3D continuum, and it does not validate lateral staircase, electrode-edge, contact, tissue or anatomy assumptions.

Independent comparison against U19 estimates vertical-FVM effects conditional on identical XY graph/contact/material inputs and the new physical-top formulation. It does not identify the full true3D error or establish SC/XY/bulk/edge/contact convergence.

The reference enforces interface V and normal J continuity analytically. This is an algebraic/model property, not independent interface accuracy evidence. Preserve old5percent failures and also recompute the same potential-only sampled2/2 and3/3 diagnostics at matching physical scopes.

Define a new field ABI: analytic Ez from -dphi/dz, with an explicitly matching discrete XY gradient. Do not call the old vertical half-face phi-to-E reconstruction and present its output as the analytic-z field. The old stored E is a half-face average and comparisons must expose this definition difference.

Native-center ROI statistics use the fixed fractional XY/exact-depth-overlap weights and remain sampled quadrature of the continuous-z solution. Analytic layer energy can be evaluated separately; do not mix a center-sampled E integral with an exact power gate without documenting quadrature error.

For later native potential probes preserve the existing5mm tip spacing, coordinates, load/attenuation distinctions and interpolation operator when comparing old results. Direct analytic-depth evaluation is an additional prediction with a different sampling definition, not silently the identical old trilinear result.
No candidate adoption, activation, safety, material/phantom calibration, hardware validation or cleared historical failures follows from this new reference method.
